text:
anya: quick heads-up — ran the quant bakeoff for new-m2-13b (FP8/INT8/GPTQ/AWQ). seeing weird variance spikes at a few stablepoints in residual mlp layers, esp layers 12, 23, 34. attaching quick summary.

matt: can you paste the per-layer delta table? curious which metric (ppl/accuracy) is spiking.

anya: pasted below, metric = prompt-ppl on eval-suite v3 (1000 prompts). baseline fp16 = 12.1. AWQ int8 median = 12.5 (+3.3%), GPTQ 4bit = 12.9 (+6.6%). FP8 prototype = 12.3 (+1.6%). but layerwise scan shows layer 23 contributes +1.8pts of ppl in AWQ -> looks like an outlier channel effect.

quant-bot: scan output: top offending channels per-layer: L23:c[142], L34:c[7], L12:c[88]. variance fold changes: 8.3x, 5.1x, 4.7x. suggested soft-clamp thresholds at 6x.

zara: can we try stablepoint gating? i.e., detect high-variance channels at runtime and apply per-channel rescale or temporary skip to FP16 for KV cache entries.

sasha: +1. also propose a 'stablepoint-scan' pass during model bring-up: run 128 calibration prompts at different seqlens, record activation stdev per channel, store a small JSON map -> used by runtime to decide gating.

kai: runtime cost wise, gating needs to be cheap. we can encode gating as bitmask per layer + scale factor table. 1 bit=skip->use fp16 path, else quant path. small overhead.

anya: prototype config (example):
```
stablepoint:
  version: 1
  layers:
    - layer: 23
      channel_mask: [False,..,True,..]
      scale: 1.12
      action: soft_rescale
    - layer: 34
      channel_mask: [True,...]
      action: skip_quant
```

matt: do we have perf numbers for bitmask lookup? if it's just a load+branch should be fine. need to measure in serving with batching.

zara: also saw some cases where channel-level clamp made AWQ better than GPTQ with zero extra cost. maybe default to per-channel clamp then skiplist only if clamp fails.

quant-bot: eval-run (awq-int8 + per-channel clamp on L23) -> ppl 12.26 (+1.2% vs fp16), latency +0.8ms p/token in 8k batch. can push config as canary.

sasha: recommend: 1) run stablepoint-scan during onboarding 2) auto-suggest clamp thresholds (6x default) 3) produce mask+scale artifact in model bundle 4) canary rollout for Dedicated.

kai: implement in runtime v0.9.2 branch: add gating table decode + fast path. i'll prototype tomorrow.

anya: great. i'll open a tiny PR with the scan script + example configs. tagging @matt @zara for review.

matt: ack. will review tonight. thanks.

zara: if PR lands, let's schedule a canary for next Tues in staging. :rocket:

buildbot: deploy scheduled by matt for canary.staging at 2026-03-25T03:00Z

anya: noted. thanks all.
